text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten at Ohi, closing out 
this fiscal year's dirt races. Her 
opponents: Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Bay, where Oi is, connects right to 
the port of Tomakomai. Hokko Tarumae said 
she wished there were some way to ship out 
the fans' burning passion.
